reproducibility_gaps: The exact pinned tree contains no source, entrypoint, pretrained model, data, architecture, training, evaluation or expected-result artifact.
README says the repository contains an implementation and pretrained models while also promising later release; neither artifact class is present.
The environment is named BioMime and embeds an author-local BioMime prefix, with no documented mapping to FENet.
README specifies Python 3.7.11 while environment.yml resolves Python 3.7.16.
The environment mixes CUDA 11.1 builds of torch/torchvision with a ROCm 4.1 build of torchaudio, while README asks for CUDA 10.1 or newer and cuDNN 7.6.3 or newer.
No Atlas-paper relationship is asserted for this non-PINN resource.
notes: R1 reflects identifiable documentation, citation, license and a detailed environment manifest. R2 and higher are blocked by the absence of source, entrypoint, data, model and evaluation artifacts.
